title: Optimal Merton's Problem under Multivariate Affine Volterra Models with Jumps
abstract: arXiv:2605.00688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper is concerned with portfolio selection for an investor with exponential, power, and logarithmic utility in multi-asset financial markets allowing jumps. We investigate the classical Merton's portfolio optimization problem in a Volterra stochastic environment described by a multivariate Volterra--Heston model with jumps driven by an independent Poisson random measure. Owing to the non-Markovian and non-semimartingale nature of the model, classical stochastic control techniques are not directly applicable. translated_title: 带跳跃的多元仿射Volterra模型下的最优Merton问题
translated_abstract: 本文研究在允许跳跃的多资产金融市场中，具有指数、幂和对数效用的投资者的投资组合选择问题。我们研究了由带跳跃的多元Volterra-Heston模型所描述的Volterra随机环境中的经典Merton投资组合优化问题，其中跳跃由独立的泊松随机测度驱动。由于该模型具有非马尔可夫性和非半鞅性，经典的随机控制技术无法直接应用。因此，本文采用鞅最优性原理来处理该问题，通过构造一族上鞅过程进行刻画，该上鞅过程由一个新颖的带跳跃的Riccati倒向随机微分方程（Riccati BSDEJ）的解来表征。所得的Merton问题的最优策略以及相应的无差别价格均以半闭形式导出，其依赖于时间相关的（方程的解，原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对带跳跃的非马尔可夫、非半鞅的多元仿射Volterra随机环境，通过鞅最优性原理和求解新颖的带跳跃Riccati倒向随机微分方程，以半闭形式给出了指数、幂和对数效用下经典Merton投资组合优化问题的最优策略及无差别价格。
en_tdlr: This paper solves the classical Merton portfolio optimization problem under exponential, power, and logarithmic utilities in a non-Markovian, non-semimartingale multivariate affine Volterra environment with jumps, deriving semi-closed-form optimal strategies and indifference prices via the martingale optimality principle and a novel Riccati BSDEJ.
